## Version and deployment / 版本与部署方式

Include commit/version, Node/Compose versions, affected entry (widget/portal/owner/API), and the stable error code/requestId when available. Do not upload tokens, .local files, backups or real customer data.

## Validation / 已进行的检查

Relevant redacted doctor result or logs. Report security issues through SECURITY.md instead of a public issue.
